Central.reason: Central Line: Severe delays while we respond to a fire alert at Shepherd's Bush. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, Liberty line, Elizabeth line, Great Western Railway, Chiltern Railways and Greater Anglia .

Circle.reason: Circle Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations

District.reason: District Line: Minor delays between Richmond and Turnham Green due to hot weather mitigation measures. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Elizabeth line.reason: A reduced service operates between Paddington and Heathrow Terminal 4 & 5 due to heat mitigation measures and earlier signal system failure.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Chalfont & Latimer and Chesham while we fix a points failure at Chalfont & Latimer. MINOR DELAYS between Rickmansworth and Amersham. SEVERE DELAYS between Moor Park and Watford due to train cancellations. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Mildmay.reason: Mildmay Line: Severe delays due to an earlier signal failure at Hackney Central. London Underground are accepting tickets via any reasonable route.
